targetGroups.description: List of target groups in the application.

id.description: Unique identifier of the target group.

name.description: Display name of the target group.

description.description: Human-readable description of the target group's purpose.

conditions.description: Targeting conditions that define which users or contexts match this group, expressed as a JSON structure.

resourceId.description: Unique identifier of the application that owns this target group.

cascUrl.description: Configuration as Code (CasC) URL for this target group.
